author: 24-7 Press
title: Boston Immigration, Criminal Defense & Family Law Firm Welch Gonzalez PLLC Launches with Proven First-Circuit Success
text:
NEW YORK, NY, December 03, 2025 /24-7PressRelease/ — Welch Gonzalez PLLC , a Boston-based law firm (see Google Maps ), announces the launch of its legal services to clients throughout Massachusetts with a particular focus on Boston (Suffolk County) and Cambridge (Middlesex County). Founded by attorneys Daniel Welch and Maximilian Gonzalez , the firm offers compassionate, bilingual (English and Spanish) representation to individuals and families facing immigration proceedings, criminal charges, or family disputes such as custody and divorce.
Attorney Welch brings a strong appellate background to the firm, having secured two published victories before the First Circuit Federal Appeals Court in immigration cases. His advocacy has been recognized beyond the legal field, including a front-page feature in The Boston Globe highlighting one of his asylum victories. Attorney Gonzalez, a Boston native with Venezuelan heritage, combines his experience in family law, civil litigation, immigration matters, and special-education cases to guide clients through legal issues that affect daily life, family stability, and long-term opportunities.
“At Welch Gonzalez PLLC, we believe that justice is earned through dedication, experience, and relentless advocacy. Whether you’re confronting the threat of deportation, facing criminal charges, or navigating a difficult family dispute, our mission is to protect your rights, dignity, and future.” By offering a wide range of services, the firm aims to meet clients’ most urgent and high-stakes legal needs with skill and compassion.
Welch Gonzalez PLLC is a Boston-based law firm delivering immigration, criminal defense, and family-law services in both English and Spanish. With a track record of published appellate-court victories and compassionate advocacy, the firm is committed to defending the rights, dignity, and future of individuals and families throughout Massachusetts.
